mechanics.description: A card that can be cast as an Instant/Sorcery Adventure, which then lets you cast the permanent side afterward.
Keyword action: draw a card, then discard a card. If the discarded card is nonland, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier token.
Static ability: once you control 3+ artifacts, legendaries, and/or Sagas, you have an "enduring story" for the rest of the game, unlocking a bonus effect.
Counters placed on Equipment; each hone counter grants +1/+0 to the equipped creature.
